instruction.text: Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: Not all flooding is bad. In some places in the world, flooding is normal and even helpful to people. Around the same time each year, heavy rain causes the Mekong River, which is the longest river in South-East Asia, to flow across land that is usually dry. The flood lasts for up to four months. As a result, many people build their houses on tall wooden poles called stilts, so that water can flow underneath them without damaging anything.

There are some positive effects when the water flows over the land. It adds new soil to the ground, which makes it easier for farmers to grow food. Many fish that live in the river also benefit from the flood because they have more space to swim and more food to eat.

atoms.a: How do people build their houses to avoid the floods?
b: they make sure they can close their windows

atoms.a: Why do fish benefit from floods?
b: they can get to land easier
++they have more space to swim and more food

b.sound: they bring new soil that is good for growing crops
they pose the threat of life-threatening injuries.

atoms.a: In general, what is a negative effect of flooding?

b.sound: homes and other buildings can be washed away.
fish have more space to swim and more food.
